description: This file defines a custom guardrail system for a language model proxy, including classes for managing guardrail behavior, exceptions for response modification, and utility functions for logging and content masking. It integrates with other litellm modules, supports event hooks, and enables response validation and dynamic configuration.

classes.name: ModifyResponseException
classes.description: Exception used to modify or replace LLM responses, enabling guardrails to return synthetic responses instead of calling the LLM.

classes.name: CustomGuardrail
classes.description: Main class implementing custom guardrail logic, including validation, logging, response handling, and decision-making for whether to run guardrails on specific events or requests.
